architecture.mechanism: Enhanced premixed combustion behavior via nickel oxide nanoparticle addition to fuel blends
architecture.intervention: Formulate a fuel additive containing Ni2O3 nanoparticles at 100 ppm concentration for the diesel variant of the internal combustion engine assembly to stabilize ignition and reduce misfires.
architecture.expected_effect: Increased peak in-cylinder pressure and maximum heat release rates leading to stable combustion cycles and elimination of misfires during normal driving.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the engine with standard fuel versus fuel enriched with 100 ppm Ni2O3 nanoparticles at 30-45 mph equivalent load; failure is confirmed if cylinder pressure traces do not show increased peak pressure or if misfire counts remain unchanged.
